assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The service is ordered to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and optimize anticoagulation management.
The service is directly tied to the documented diagnosis codes I48.0 and R00.2.
The ordered procedure is required to support ongoing anticoagulation management in a patient with a history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
